description: This file defines a custom exception class `HttpProtocolException` used for representing HTTP protocol errors within the Eclipse Hono project. It extends `ServiceInvocationException` and provides constructors for various error scenarios, as well as static utility methods for transforming and asserting protocol errors.

classes.name: HttpProtocolException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for errors related to HTTP protocol adapter interactions within the Hono framework.

methods.name: HttpProtocolException
methods.description: Constructors for creating instances of the exception with specific error code, message, and cause.

methods.name: transformInto
methods.description: Converts a `ServiceInvocationException` into an `HttpProtocolException` wrapped in a Vert.x `Future.failedFuture`, or passes through other exceptions unchanged.

methods.name: assertProtocolError
methods.description: Asserts that a given Throwable is an `HttpProtocolException` with the expected error code.
